ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the diagram, what structure is located in the human head?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a side sectional view of the human respiratory system. The upper part shows a section of the head, including the nose, oral cavity, and the air passage behind/inside the nose; the lower part shows the neck, trachea, and lungs inside the chest cavity. Reasoning: The question asks, according to the diagram, which structure is located in the human head. The respiratory passage located in the head, inside the nose or behind the nose, is anatomically called the nasal cavity. Therefore the answer is nasal cavity.
